## Description

Briefly describe the change and the motivation behind it.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Template metadata / release version update

## Checklist

- [ ] Local tests pass: `node --test tests/template.test.mjs`
- [ ] Changes tested in GTM Template Editor **Tests** tab
- [ ] Verified in GTM **Preview** mode with sample Aggregate deployment
- [ ] Parameter names, field labels, and descriptions follow GTM Style Guide
- [ ] Script and global permissions in `template.tpl` are strictly minimal
- [ ] If preparing a release, `metadata.yaml` has been updated with the release commit SHA
